summary: POSITION: the correct output of this review is 3 corrections-of-fact and ZERO changes to any obligation. The case rests on five verified measurements. (1) The mechanism that actually froze src/ is NOT in any rule file: 6 of the gauntlet workflow SCRIPTS carry 'This lane touches no source code', a prohibition strictly wider than GAUNTLET.md:236 whose NO-TOUCH list names only two files. No edit to CLAUDE.md or GAUNTLET.md unblocks it; arming a chopping lane does, and needs zero edits. (2) The review's own lenses agree: 33 of the 102 findings (32.4%) carry word_delta 0, and ~25 of those explicitly say NO RULE CHANGE - including C78, C88, C90, C100 and C102, the five that price the highest-value work available. The rules are not the constraint. (3) The finding set does not converge and therefore cannot be applied as authored: GAUNTLET.md:193-196 (33 words) has FOUR mutually exclusive rewrites (C52 pool-shrink / C58 delete outright / C63 budget clause / C79 gain proof); CLAUDE.md:36 has C24 saying DELETE while C1/C2/C18/C19 add clauses to it; CLAUDE.md:49 has C48 DELETE against C6/C26/C35 KEEP-AND-ENFORCE; src/config/CLAUDE.md:14-16 has C5/C96 DELETE against C45 REPLACE. Picking among them is arbitration, not evidence. (4) C62 (git rm 26 kickoffs, -64,329 words) destroys the cited evidence base of C16, C20, C21, C92 and C93 - I verified STAGE2_KICKOFF.md:73-74 and STAGE4_KICKOFF.md:22-23 exist and carry exactly the text those findings quote. It also single-handedly satisfies ARCH-E, making every one of the +985 words of additions free; passing the anti-bloat gate would prove nothing. (5) The one standing-rule edit of the entire gauntlet era (7476add, the ONLY edit to GAUNTLET.md in 50 commits) is now itself accused of carrying a falsehood by L3/C33 - and that accusation is against a strawman: the text says serial spend 'MAY NEVER hit the limit at all', explicitly probabilistic, and the doc already subordinates that bullet in its own next clause ('the second is the one that actually forces it'). Base rate of rule edits in this era producing a later complaint: 1 for 1. AGAINST THE LEAD SPECIFICALLY: L2's harm claim is counterfactually void (GAUNTLET.md:139-141 queues L2/L3 behind L0 regardless of §2.1, so no session could have armed them anyway); L3 attacks a bullet the doc already labels non-binding, written by the owner; L6's 6th artifact tier is redundant - src/config/combat.ts:106 already quotes the decompiled line inline (an A2 cite) and config values are pinned by tests/config-values.test.ts (an A3 cite), so the taxonomy had the slot and nobody grepped; worse, the tier would gate evidence on a CONTRACT label that I verified NO test parses. HONEST CONCESSIONS - THREE, all corrections of FACT, none changing an obligation: src/config/CLAUDE.md:14-16 states the reverse of a live owner ruling; src/config/CLAUDE.md:6 advertises 'test-enforced' for a label invariant no test enforces; GAUNTLET.md §2.1's factual claim that the string table is missing is false (correct it in place per C34, do not delete the rule per L2/C60/C98). Net -31 words. HONEST LIMIT ON MY OWN CASE: C40 is right - I grepped, and only walls #5,#6,#8,#9,#10,#11 have any written record. 'Eleven walls, zero data lost' is auditable for six. That weakens the shield around the process rules, and I say so rather than lean on it.

findings.claim: ARCH-E, the review's anti-bloat gate, is defeated by one finding: C62's -64,329 words makes every one of the ~985 words of proposed additions free, so passing ARCH-E would prove nothing about restraint.

- **ARCH-E** Total net change to standing-rule word count is **≤ 0**. The rules may be
  sharper; they may not be longer. *(This is the anti-bloat gate. It is deliberately harsh.)*

Sum of positive word_deltas across all 102 findings: ~ +985.
Sum of negative deltas excluding C62: ~ -2,232 — but that figure is inflated 3-4x by double-counting: GAUNTLET §7 (226 words) is claimed at -226 by THREE findings (C61, C68, C75) plus lead L1; §5 by C59 (-524) and again by C69 (-5) and C76 (-5); §2.1/L1b by C60 (-300), C98 (-242), L2 (-231) and C34 (-80) for the same block; src/config/CLAUDE.md:14-16 by C5 (-6), C45 (-8) and C96 (-29).
Deduplicated, the genuinely distinct deletions are roughly -1,430, against +985 of genuinely distinct additions.
With C62 included the total is about -65,576, i.e. ARCH-E passes by a factor of 60 on the strength of deleting 26 archive documents that are not standing rules at all.
findings.proposed_change: NONE to ARCH-E — it is one commit old (2df2f87) and has never been applied, so amending it now is churn on a rule with no incident record, which is the exact error this review is meant to avoid. Instead: apply ARCH-E to STANDING RULE FILES ONLY (CLAUDE.md, GAUNTLET.md, .claude/ship-bar.md, the three folder CLAUDE.mds) and exclude the docs/sessions/ archive from the count. Under that reading, the do-nothing output of -31 words passes ARCH-E honestly and every alternative fails it.

A finding density of 1-per-45-words against a corpus that produced ZERO src/ commits in 60 tries is not a measurement of the rules. No game code moves.').
findings.rule_targeted: NONE — argument about the review itself
findings.proposed_change: NONE. The correct response to a 109-finding return on a 4,855-word rule corpus is to notice that the yield says more about the instrument than the subject, and to ship the review as a report with three fact corrections and one arming decision. C72 reached the same place from the other side: 'every one of its six gate items can be passed with document edits alone' — which is the reason to distrust document edits as this review's output, not the reason to make more of them.
